nodes.label: review-loop SKILL.md
nodes.description: Project skill defining how to triage manual review feedback after an automated verify pass, distinguishing mechanical fixes from spec gaps.

nodes.label: sdd-verify (automated verify)
nodes.description: Automated verification step that checks work against a spec; review-loop triggers after this passes but a human still finds issues.

nodes.label: Mechanical fix
nodes.description: Feedback category where the spec was correct but the implementation missed it (e.g. wrong color, spacing, copy).

nodes.label: Spec gap
nodes.description: Feedback category where the built behavior matches the spec, but the spec itself was wrong or incomplete.
